objective: Bring 12 Tunnel Rat Ears to Mountaineer Kadrell in Thelsamar.

description: We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!
We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.
You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
progress: Hail, <name>. How goes the rat catching?
completion: Ugh! When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!
